services.desc: We’re celebrating 70 years of go-kart racing at K1 Circuit on Friday, August 28, 2026! Art Ingels and his buddy Lou Borelli invented the go-kart in August 1956 in a Los Angeles garage. Ingels, a fabricator for racecar shop Kurtis Kraft, came up with the idea of a miniature racer that resembled the kinds of chassis Kurtis Kraft created for their midget racers. Borelli then found a way of mounting a surplus lawnmower engine to the kart, and, voila! The go-kart was born. You can learn more about this moment in history by watching K1 Speed’s video about the invention of the go-kart.
